children: SaveLend Group AB entered a partnership with Kleer Group AB to finance invoice purchases on Kleer’s platform, adding short-term invoice volumes to SaveLend’s factoring operations.
Adds new invoice volumes that can lift fee income and AUM.
Improves turnover and potential yield; diversifies credit mix.
Shows rapid growth; more than 2x full-year 2025 levels.

This is a mid-cycle expansion building on a fast-growing factoring line within SaveLend’s platform model. For a larger catalyst, investors need quantified volume commitments, margin impact, default metrics, or guidance tying the deal to 2026 revenue/EBIT targets.
